items.desc: Two years after the Mazan rape trial, David Pelicot has decided to put his name to the fight against sexual violence – and to confront what he calls the silence of men.

items.title: Somalia: Famine risk decreases in Baidoa – but millions still going hungry
items.desc: Millions of people in Somalia still face severe food shortages and malnutrition despite the reduced risk of famine in Baidoa, global food security experts warned on Wednesday.

items.title: Yemen war: Emergency aid chief calls for access to war-hit communities
items.desc: The UN’s top aid official, Tom Fletcher, arrived in Yemen on Wednesday warning that the war there is preventing families from accessing the food and medicine they need to survive, particularly those in Taiz City.
